name: Video_pipeline_plan
status: PREPARED-NOT-ACTIVATED (owner deferred model download and first generation)

capability.model: MiniMax H3 FL2VA (already on disk for illustration) is natively a VIDEO model; ComfyUI 0.38 ships MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo / ReferenceToVideo / AddGuide + AV latent nodes and blueprint 'Image to Video (MiniMax H3).json'
capability.shot_length: 124-362 frames @24fps = 5.2-15.1s trained range (17k+5 frame grid; param max 3600 untested)
capability.audio: H3 generates synced audio; decoding requires audio VAE (pending file)
capability.long_video: chaining: last frame of shot N = first frame of shot N+1; REF2VA weights (21GB, not downloaded) for reference consistency; this local workflow has not validated minute-level single-shot

pending_files.note: download via scripts/seq_dl_video.ps1 (ModelScope Comfy-Org/minimax-H3); hashes pre-registered in models/SHA256SUMS

wiring: run_video.py [UNVALIDATED]: UNETLoader -> LoraLoaderModelOnly(turbo,1.0) ; CLIPLoader(minimax) ; VAELoader(video int8) ; LoadImage(upload via /upload/image) -> MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo(1344x768, snapped length, first_frame) -> BasicGuider(pos) + ConditioningZeroOut + RandomNoise + KSamplerSelect(res_multistep) + BasicScheduler(simple,8,1.0) -> SamplerCustomAdvanced -> VAEDecode -> CreateVideo(24fps) -> SaveVideo(mp4). Audio decode path intentionally omitted (silent video); add VAEDecodeAudio from blueprint at activation.

quality_reference.verdict: H3 vs Seedance 2.5 evenly matched, different personalities: H3 wins cinematic coherence/space stability/character consistency/synced audio/long-prompt understanding, errs by omission; Seedance wins precise camera-control execution/native 30s/multi-reference, errs by hallucination (e.g. ship on concrete). H3 called open-source SOTA.
quality_reference.caveat: we run int8 quantized local (vs API full bf16 in that test); for game-asset micro-motion H3 strengths are the relevant ones
quality_reference.seedance_pricing_then: H3 API 2K RMB0.8/s + open weights; Seedance closed, prev-gen 720P ~RMB1/s, 1080P >RMB2/s

director_roadmap.phase1: first-run validation of run_video.py, one 5s I2V acceptance shot (e.g. dog_alert illustration as first frame)
director_roadmap.phase2: director.py + shots.json schema (shot list: prompt/first-frame/duration/audio cues) -> keyframes via H3 image line (style anchor) -> shots via I2V -> BGM via Music 3 -> spot SFX via MOSS -> ffmpeg concat/crossfade/loudnorm; first target 60-90s short (8-12 shots)
director_roadmap.phase3: consistency suite (OmniChar .char files / REF2VA 21GB) for character-driven work; precedent: github.com/AEON-7/aeon-radio-drama built the audio version of exactly this pipeline on identical hardware (5090 + ComfyUI + ffmpeg mix)

implementation_update.status: P0-P3 software implemented; GPU quality validation separate
